hematology-h12.title: 免疫共同语言、超敏反应与自身耐受
hematology-h12.first_pass_focus: 只建立Source支持的最低免疫语言，用效应器、靶点和时相区分I–IV型损伤并明确耐受边界。
hematology-h12.stop_line: 不补完整补体、APC、细胞因子、淋巴细胞发育/抗体转换。
hematology-h12.recall_spine: 最低免疫字典 + 分类起手式 → Ⅰ–Ⅳ型 → 同病跨型 + 免疫复合物多器官接口 → 自身耐受与宿主反应 → 免疫损伤病例算法

c-h12-lg01.label: 最低免疫字典 + 分类起手式
c-h12-lg01.goal: establish only B/antibody, CD4 helper, CD8 cytotoxic, immune-complex and complement/leukocyte-damage interfaces, then classify immune injury by time, effector and target rather than disease name.
c-h12-lg01.closure: given an unfamiliar immune-injury vignette, name the effector/target question to ask next and explicitly state which normal-immunology mechanism is outside Current Source.
c-h12-lg01.continuity_rationale: vocabulary and classification order are one prerequisite; neither warrants a standalone full immunology lesson.

c-h12-lg02.label: Ⅰ–Ⅳ型：四种损伤动作，不是四张疾病名单
c-h12-lg02.goal: distinguish rapid allergy, antibody-direct fixed-target injury, immune-complex deposition and T-cell delayed injury using mechanism/time/location; the summary table is retrieval compression only.
c-h12-lg02.closure: classify a new example by mechanism and explain why an antibody-related disease can still be II or III depending on what the antibody is doing.
c-h12-lg02.continuity_rationale: KP03–06 define the four actions; KP07 compresses them. Full effector detail absent from Source remains absent.

c-h12-lg03.label: 同病跨型 + 免疫复合物多器官接口
c-h12-lg03.goal: prevent disease-name pattern matching by comparing SLE overall vs cytopenia, most GN vs anti-GBM, and rejection subtypes; use immune-complex deposition as a reusable but bounded multi-organ interface.
c-h12-lg03.closure: when the same named disease presents with a different target/lesion, reclassify the mechanism instead of forcing one hypersensitivity label onto the whole disease.
c-h12-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP08 tests the classification model; KP09 supplies the recurrent III-type interface while preserving the missing complement/deposition mechanism boundary.

c-h12-lg04.label: 自身耐受与宿主反应：知道边界，不把缺 Source 补成理论课
c-h12-lg04.goal: understand tolerance as the brake preventing self-directed attack and recognize that both excessive/misdirected response and insufficient response can damage tissue.
c-h12-lg04.closure: explain why autoimmune injury can occur after tolerance failure and why severe immunodeficiency can show abundant pathogens but weak classic granulomatous response, while explicitly refusing to list unsupported tolerance-loss mechanisms.
c-h12-lg04.continuity_rationale: these KPs define the two-system boundary that feeds rheumatology and infection; H12-SG01/H12-SG02 stay open.

c-h12-lg05.label: 免疫损伤病例算法
c-h12-lg05.goal: execute time → effector → target/deposition site → special manifestation → disease owner.
c-h12-lg05.closure: solve a fresh immune-injury case and, when Source conflicts exist, separate “table classification”, “specific pathology” and “attack direction” instead of silently harmonizing them.

hematology-h13.title: 免疫缺陷与 HIV / AIDS
hematology-h13.first_pass_focus: 先定位T/B/联合/粒细胞功能缺陷，再把HIV/CD4损伤与机会感染/肿瘤放回宿主失败模型。
hematology-h13.stop_line: 不补完整ART和传染病治疗/病原谱。
hematology-h13.recall_spine: 免疫缺陷先定位故障层 → HIV identity/entry/reservoir/transmission → 淋巴组织时间轴 → AIDS downstream outputs → 反向定位算法

c-h13-lg01.label: 免疫缺陷先定位故障层
c-h13-lg01.goal: separate primary vs acquired and T / B / combined / granulocyte-function defects using four Source-supported prototypes.
c-h13-lg01.closure: from recurrent-infection context, state whether the defect is number/development vs function and map DiGeorge, Bruton, SCID and CGD without inventing a complete pathogen spectrum.
c-h13-lg01.continuity_rationale: the four prototypes are not a disease list; they calibrate the four failure layers.

c-h13-lg02.label: HIV identity, entry, reservoir and transmission
c-h13-lg02.goal: connect RNA-virus identity → gp120/CD4/co-receptor entry → CD4 as main damaged cell vs macrophage/FDC reservoirs → Source-listed transmission/fluids.
c-h13-lg02.closure: distinguish “main target” from “long-term reservoir” and reconstruct entry/transmission without adding replication-cycle, ART or public-health algorithms absent from Source.
c-h13-lg02.continuity_rationale: these KPs form one upstream viral persistence/entry model.

c-h13-lg03.label: 淋巴组织时间轴：早增生，晚耗竭
c-h13-lg03.goal: connect early follicular response to late lymphocyte/white-pulp depletion and organ-specific spleen/thymus changes.
c-h13-lg03.closure: explain why lymphoid-organ enlargement can coexist with ineffective immunity and why late-stage tissue can contain many pathogens but little organized immune architecture.
c-h13-lg03.continuity_rationale: lymph node, spleen and thymus are different views of progressive immune-system collapse.

c-h13-lg04.label: AIDS downstream outputs：机会感染、肿瘤与“病原多但肉芽肿少”
c-h13-lg04.goal: integrate antibody positivity/CD4 decline with opportunistic infections, Kaposi/lymphoma risk and altered host pathology.
c-h13-lg04.closure: from infection/tumor/tissue-reaction clues, infer immune-host failure while stating why one pathogen cannot uniquely identify one defect under the Current Source boundary.
c-h13-lg04.continuity_rationale: these are the clinical/pathologic outputs of the upstream HIV/immune-defect model. H13-SR01 remains explicit.

c-h13-lg05.label: 反向定位算法
c-h13-lg05.goal: execute primary/acquired → T/B/combined/granulocyte-function → number vs function → host reaction → HIV-specific evidence.
c-h13-lg05.closure: solve a fresh recurrent/opportunistic-infection vignette without using an unsupported encyclopedic “organism → immune defect” lookup.

hematology-h14.title: 移植排斥与 GVHD
hematology-h14.first_pass_focus: 先判谁攻击谁，再按时间/血管/细胞形态区分排斥与GVHD。
hematology-h14.stop_line: 不扩移植医学指南或把Source冲突静默统一。
hematology-h14.recall_spine: 排斥 vs GVHD攻击方向 → 超急性 → 急性/慢性形态轴 + Source conflicts

c-h14-lg01.label: 第一问永远是谁攻击谁：排斥 vs GVHD
c-h14-lg01.goal: separate recipient→graft rejection from graft immune cells→recipient GVHD, connect HLA mismatch to rejection intensity and state the two conditions for GVHD; include transfusion-related GVHD as the same attack direction from a different source.
c-h14-lg01.closure: distinguish organ rejection, ordinary transfusion hemolysis, bone-marrow GVHD and transfusion-GVHD purely by attacker/target/source before using any timing or pathology clue.
c-h14-lg01.continuity_rationale: KP12 belongs semantically with direction and preconditions even though it is last in stable KP order; no identity change occurs.

c-h14-lg02.label: 超急性：预存抗体造成分钟—小时血管灾难
c-h14-lg02.goal: connect three rejection time classes to the specific hyperacute sequence: pre-existing HLA/ABO antibody → small-artery injury/fibrinoid necrosis → fibrin thrombosis → ischemic graft necrosis.
c-h14-lg02.closure: recognize hyperacute rejection from time + preexisting-antibody + vascular pathology and state why waiting for a new cellular response is not required.
c-h14-lg02.continuity_rationale: time, trigger and pathology are one causal chain.

c-h14-lg03.label: 急性 / 慢性形态轴 + Source conflicts
c-h14-lg03.goal: distinguish acute vascular intimal thickening, acute cellular CD4/CD8 interstitial infiltration and chronic intimal fibrosis, then keep the hyperacute II/III and chronic IV/humoral Source conflicts explicitly layered.
c-h14-lg03.closure: from time/pathology/immune wording, choose the correct morphology first and explain how the answer changes if the question instead asks for the Study hypersensitivity-table label or current mechanism wording.
c-h14-lg03.continuity_rationale: KP07–10 are one time–morphology comparison; KP11 exists specifically to prevent silent harmonization of that comparison.
